errors.text: The proposed L12-(Ni,Fe)3Ti phase is not supported by the cited evidence for this Fe-Co-Ni-Ti composition; the relevant citation concerns mechanically strengthening L12 precipitates in an Al-containing alloy, not magnetic coercivity.
The central claim that L12 precipitation reverses orbital-moment quenching is asserted without electronic-structure, XMCD, or magnetic-anisotropy evidence.
The hypothesis misses the target C14 Laves phase, Ti-sublattice antiferromagnetic coupling, and phase-specific magnetic transitions that explain the observed high-temperature coercivity.
